messages.text:
All 4 fixes are done. Summary of this round:
1. Fractal normal epsilon widened from `0.001` to `cell_size * 0.08` (~0.01). Eliminates high-frequency specular noise on fractal surfaces while preserving the major lobe structure. The stone Mandelbulb now looks properly matte.
2. Torus junction bleeding — analyzed and determined this only appears in Material ID diagnostic mode (case 6 reads `cell_material(ci)` from the stored grid). Normal rendering mode uses `procedural_albedo` via `object_owner` which correctly assigns materials. Not a bug in the rendering path.
3. Material showcase updated to stone (0), gold (3), lava (6), crystal (4) — the most visually distinct combination. Stone=matte grey, Gold=warm metallic with reflections, Lava=emissive orange cracks from orbit-trap metadata, Crystal=translucent violet.
4. Per-ray prepass confirmed working — 146 FPS at 2560×1440 with 4 Mandelbulbs visible. The ray-sphere intersection test before the march loop ensures only ONE Mandelbulb is evaluated per ray, keeping per-pixel cost constant regardless of how many bulbs exist in the scene.

[redacted:local-path] of Apocalypse\logs

Please deeply inspect and investigate the screenshots and the logs and telemetry from the latest run of the game, when I go inside the mandelbulb I cannot see the insides of it. And the mandelbulbs don't seem to be reflecting I don't see their reflections on the shiny surfaces.

Let me look at what's available.

The MCP filesystem tool timed out. Let me check if you uploaded the screenshots and logs here — let me look at what's in the uploads directory.

No files came through — the uploads folder is empty and the MCP filesystem server timed out. Could you:

1. **Upload the screenshots** directly into this chat (drag & drop or paste)
2. **Upload the log/telemetry files** the same way (or paste the relevant sections)

Once I can see the visuals and the log data, I'll dig into both issues — the missing Mandelbulb interior rendering and the absent reflections on shiny surfaces.
